codeInventory.finding: PokedexRecord exposes optional raw breeding fields and permits unknown keys.
Pokémon sheets contain editable eggGroups, eggMoves, inheritedMoves, Gender, Nature, Ability, and babyTemplate compatibility fields.
Trainer sheets link only currentTeam and boxedPokemon and have no Egg roster or species-acquisition history.
Sheet normalization materializes editable inheritance and Egg Move containers but creates no provenance.
Egg Move choices are derived from editable sheet rows, not parent snapshots or a compiled registry.
Inherited Move UI exposes fixed Level 20–90 slots and omits the Level 100 checkpoint.
Egg Move rows remain directly editable legacy sheet data.
Documentary wild generator randomly chooses zero to three species Egg Moves and uses process-local randomness without parent or operation provenance.
Documentary emitter copies generated Egg and inherited move rows into ordinary sheet fields.
Upstream Edge contract delegates canonical Breeder requests to breeding.v1.
Upstream campaign planner checks effective Breeder and emits the closed edge.breeder.request.v1 delegation.
Legacy Egg Warmer availability reads map.metadata.capabilityEggs and integer hatchHours.
Legacy Egg Warmer mutates map metadata through a map-scoped capability command; this is not accepted Egg authority.
Capability commands and results are map-scoped and cannot own Workshop Egg mutations.
SQLite schema version 21 has no breeding project, Egg, consent, roll, operation, clock, or acquisition tables.
Sheet repository supports only Trainer and Pokémon sheets and can be transactionally composed for complete child insertion.

existingAuthority.detail: Effective Breeder permission and Pokémon Education contribution terminate at breeding.v1.
Revision checks, complete document insertion, operation-ledger, and SQLite transaction patterns may be composed without adding an Egg sheet kind.
Raw optional PokedexRecord strings are canonical input but are not safe runtime breeding specs.
Wild generation cannot create projects, Eggs, parent snapshots, rolls, or lineage.
eggGroups, eggMoves, inheritedMoves, Gender, Nature, Ability, and babyTemplate do not establish breeding provenance.
map.metadata.capabilityEggs and hatchHours conflict with first-class campaign Eggs and Workshop ownership.

acceptedBoundaries: Eggs remain dedicated campaign aggregates and never become a third sheet kind.
Normal breeding and hatching never require map, placement, scene, initiative, or interaction mode.
Only app-owned JSON and reviewed generated artifacts may feed runtime mechanics.
Current editable sheet fields remain compatibility projections until typed origin migration.
Legacy Egg Warmer capability behavior must become a contribution to breeding.v1 before map metadata authority is removed.
